moat_type: Artificial Intelligence and Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Technology
primary_risk: Dependence on the growth of the gaming and data center markets
sector_survival_note: The company's AI and GPU technology has been a dominant force in the industry for over a decade, and it is likely to remain so for at least 20 years.
thesis_summary: NVIDIA Corporation's specific moat is its artificial intelligence and graphics processing unit (GPU) technology, which it rides on the big trend of growing demand for AI and data center services.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural change in the demand for AI and data center services, or a significant improvement in competing technologies.
sentiment_note: The company's valuation is rich, but its fundamentals support a long-term hold.
ten_k_highlights: The company's revenue has been rising at a rate of 702.3% over the past 5 years.
The company's gross margin has been rising over the past 13 years, from 43.6% to 74%.
The company's return on invested capital (ROIC) has been rising over the past 13 years, from 15.6% to 67%.
valuation_note: FCF yield 2.4%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 30, P/S 20 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
implied_growth_note: The price already assumes strong growth for a decade — accumulate slowly.
